summary: All Bob's Bots tiers share the same entry TA core. Tiers differ by risk tuning, throughput, and intelligence add-ons — not a different indicator stack.

core_ta.label: Shared entry brain (every tier)
core_ta.confluence: 15+ weighted votes; need ~52% agreement and 5+ agreeing methods before a direction counts
core_ta.exit_ta: Exchange-native TP/SL (3R fast lane: ~1% stop / ~3% take) — exits are price brackets, not separate indicator sells

god-bot-ml-cortex: Optional LLM policy overlay on same confluence baseline
universe-scanner: Symbol ratings only — momentum + quality composite tiers
Does not change entry TA; ranks which coins to scan

backtest_lab_note: Backtest Lab runs bobs_bots/ engine: full ta_confluence.py on Blofin 5m+1H with per-bot gate profiles and 3R bracket simulation.
